Cash-only consideration of $61.25 per Company Share (no stock, CVRs, or other forms).
Merger consideration components: (i) Per Share Merger Consideration: cash of $61.25 per Company Share; (ii) cash-out of Restricted Stock Rights equal to the product of the number of shares subject to such Restricted Stock Right multiplied by the Per Share Merger Consideration, plus 6% interest, less applicable taxes; (iii) cash-out of Earned Performance Shares equal to the product of the number of such shares multiplied by the Per Share Merger Consideration, plus 6% interest, less applicable taxes; (iv) payment of fair value for Dissenting Shares under Section 53-15-4 (net of withholding), and (v) a stock exchange ratio where Merger Sub Shares are converted 1-for-1 into Surviving Corporation Shares.
